Automatic Lessons

Why more learners are choosing automatic

With no clutch and no gear changes to worry about, you can put all your attention where it belongs — reading the road, staying safe and enjoying the drive. Many learners find they progress faster and feel calmer behind the wheel.

  • No clutch control and no stalling at junctions
  • Less to think about, so lessons feel relaxed
  • Full focus on road awareness and hazard spotting
  • Ideal for nervous learners and busy city driving
Female Instructor

Learn in comfort, with confidence

Learning to drive can feel daunting — especially your first time behind the wheel. At KB you learn with a calm, patient female instructor who explains everything clearly, never rushes you, and builds your confidence lesson by lesson.

It is a supportive environment where questions are always welcome — popular with women learners, nervous beginners and anyone returning to driving after a break.

FAQs

Questions, answered

Do you only teach automatic?
Yes — KB Driving School specialises in automatic lessons only. There is no clutch and no gear changes, so you can focus fully on the road. Please note an automatic licence lets you drive automatic cars.
Who is the instructor?
All lessons are with a friendly, patient female instructor. The calm, supportive style is especially popular with nervous learners and women who prefer learning with a female instructor.
Which areas do you cover?
Goodmayes, Chingford, Loughton, Hornchurch and surrounding areas. If you are nearby but not listed, call 07492 585110 and ask — we will always try to help.
How do I book?
The fastest way is to call or text 07492 585110. You can also send the booking form on the Contact page and we will come back to you to confirm your lesson.
Can I book around work or college?
Yes. Flexible booking is one of our key promises — lessons are arranged around your work, college and family commitments wherever possible.
What car will I learn in?
You will learn in a modern white Toyota Corolla automatic — the car shown on this page and on our business card. It is comfortable, easy to drive and ideal for learning.

Our Approach

Why learners choose KB

Many people delay learning to drive because they worry about gears, stalling, or feeling rushed by an instructor. KB removes all three worries. Every lesson is automatic-only, taught at your pace, with clear explanations and plenty of encouragement.

Because we are local, your lessons happen on real local roads — the same junctions, roundabouts and routes you will use every day once you pass, including practice around local test areas.

  • One-to-one lessons — your instructor, every time
  • Structured progress, explained in plain English
  • A calm environment for nervous and first-time learners
  • Flexible booking around work, college and family
What We Stand For

The KB standard

Patience First

Everyone learns at a different speed. You will never be shouted at, rushed or made to feel silly for asking a question — ask as many as you like.

Safety Always

Good driving is safe driving. Lessons build proper observation, anticipation and road awareness — skills that stay with you long after the test.

Honest & Simple

Clear pricing by phone, no pressure selling, and honest advice about when you are genuinely ready for your test.

Pricing FAQs

Before you book

Why are prices not listed here?
Prices can vary by area and package, and block booking offers change. Calling keeps it simple and honest — you get the exact current price for your lessons, with no obligation.
Do I need a provisional licence?
Yes — you will need a valid UK provisional driving licence before your first lesson, and you must meet the minimum eyesight requirement. If you are unsure, ask when you call.
Can I pay per lesson?
Yes — single lessons are pay-as-you-go. If you plan regular lessons, ask about block booking on your call, as it usually works out better value.
What if I need to rearrange a lesson?
Life happens — just call or text as early as you can and we will do our best to move your lesson to a time that suits you.
